blurb: Gold Canyon RV & Golf Resort is a 55+ active-adult community offering wide, paved RV sites with full hookups and mountain views. Guests can enjoy a 9-hole executive golf course, two heated pools, multiple pickleball and tennis courts, a fitness center, and a 40,000 sq. ft. clubhouse. The resort features a full social calendar with live entertainment, crafts, cards, and other activities.
extraNote: $500 deposit secures reservation · New bookings only, limited availability
